title: The Broken List
subtitle: Read this before you submit a level or a record

chapters.label: Level placement
chapters.intro: What a level needs before staff will put it on the list.
rules: Minimum difficulty is Hard. Below that does not get considered.
Minimum length is 30 seconds. There is no max length.
Someone must have beaten it on video. No theory-only placements.
Staff rank by how hard it is to finish, not by fame or deco alone.
Two-player levels are judged as solo unless staff say otherwise.
If the intended path is a secret route or a major bug, the level can be rejected or removed later.
Staff can move or drop a level later if new proof shows up.
Suggesting a level does not mean it gets in. Staff decide when they have time.

chapters.label: Record videos
chapters.intro: Your video has to prove the run is real. Missing any of this usually means a deny.
rules: No hacks. Noclip, speedhacks, and illegal physics mods are out.
Only 240 TPS is allowed. Below 240 or above 240 is invalid. TPS bypass must land on exactly 240.
Play the exact listed level (correct ID / version).
Audio needs click or tap sounds, or clear input audio.
Show a previous attempt and the full death before the completion (skip only on a true first attempt).
Show your total attempt count on screen so it is readable.
Show CPS and a cheat indicator if your mod menu can display them.
The run must reach the Level Complete screen.
No bug routes or secret routes unless that path is the listed one.
No easy modes, start-pos completions, or editor playtests as records.
One continuous take is better. Heavy cuts around death to clear will get questioned.
Mobile is fine if the video still shows the required info.

chapters.label: Allowed tools
chapters.intro: These are fine. If something is not listed here, ask before you grind.
rules: CBF (Click Between Frames) — allowed.
Click on Steps — allowed.
TPS / FPS bypass — allowed at exactly 240 TPS only. Under or over 240 is not accepted.
Mod menus for CPS, attempts, indicators, or recording helpers — allowed.
Anything that changes physics beyond CBF / Click on Steps / locked 240 TPS — not allowed.

chapters.label: Quality bar
rules: Levels should actually be playable, not deco with no real gameplay.
Staff can reject levels that only exist to inflate difficulty with impossible spam.
Staff may ask for another video, raw footage, or a cleaner recording.
Staff have final say. Discord fights do not change the video.

chapters.label: Legacy
rules: When a level falls off Extended, it goes to Legacy.
New records are accepted for about 24 hours after it falls, then the level is closed.
Legacy stays on the site so old completions do not disappear.

chapters.label: Roulette
rules: Roulette is just a local challenge. It does not submit list records.
Progress saves in your browser. Export if you switch devices.
You can give up any time. Results stay on your machine unless you share them.

chapters.label: Conduct
rules: Do not harass staff, verifiers, creators, or other players.
Faked records, stolen footage, or edited completions can get you banned from submitting.
Talk rulings out on Discord calmly. Spam and threats get ignored or muted.
Rules can change when the list needs it. Check back if you submit rarely.

chapters.label: Common denies
chapters.intro: If you got denied, it is usually one of these.
rules: No clicks on the audio.
No death before the completion (and it was not a first attempt).
Attempt count / CPS / cheat indicator missing when the menu supports them.
Video ends before the complete screen.
Wrong level ID or a different version.
TPS is not exactly 240 (under or over both fail).
Bug route or secret route that is not the listed path.
Private or deleted video link on the form.
